whyItMatters: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `URL` field over cleartext.
actions: Use the HTTPS endpoint the registry publishes and keep the hostname in the configuration reviewable. Specifically: fix a `URL` field over cleartext.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm DESCRIPTION no longer carries a `URL` field over cleartext.
